WITH matched_fees AS (
  SELECT f.feerate, f.rebrate, o.mktnote
  FROM fees f
  INNER JOIN orders o ON f.orderslink = o.recordvault
),
pair_avg_net_fees AS (
  SELECT mktnote, AVG(feerate - rebrate) as avg_net_fee_rate
  FROM matched_fees
  GROUP BY mktnote
),
benchmark AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_net_fee_rate) as benchmark_rate
  FROM pair_avg_net_fees
),
above_benchmark AS (
  SELECT pnf.avg_net_fee_rate, b.benchmark_rate
  FROM pair_avg_net_fees pnf
  CROSS JOIN benchmark b
  WHERE b.benchmark_rate IS NOT NULL AND pnf.avg_net_fee_rate > b.benchmark_rate
)
SELECT
  AVG(avg_net_fee_rate) as average_net_fee_rate,
  AVG(avg_net_fee_rate - benchmark_rate) as average_excess_over_benchmark
FROM above_benchmark;
